correctness.rtl: Arabic bidi runs accepted in existing LTR caller; CSS RTL root rejection unchanged, not full RTL-root performance

scope.time: Four balanced fresh counter-free CPU10 processes per state,7 samples per32 conditions, all builds/checks finished first. Caller windows sum is prepare+break+projection ns for each sample; excludes context creation, parse/cascade, fonts, index-control and serialization/releases; not end-to-end/frame time. Standalone index control runs after actual projection in final source. All initial/pilot time captures are controls only.
scope.phases: Actual index construction and link-loop timing in visit overlay only; index_ns subtracted from enclosing trace phase duration. Instrumentation time is diagnostic, never adoption speed evidence. Standalone index-control is independent, not added/subtracted to infer actual projection cost.
scope.memory: Requested allocator gross/net/peak, each window and owner release separate, not RSS. Retention after output release sums prepare/break/projection/output-release net; context construction, parsed input and configured shared fonts outside these windows. Owner context release includes allocations made before prepare, so it is not inverse measured setup. Local mapping-order cache is stack-only and no new persistent index retained.
scope.algorithm: Check start and end monotonicity per consecutive mapping identity, validate every source once per identity including unaccepted/collapsed nodes, binary search only checked ordered mappings, otherwise retain original full scan. Keep source order and one query per eligible original unit; do not memoize nonexistent duplicates. Trace separately counts unit-loop visits, source lookups, validation lookups and order/window comparisons.
scope.limitations: No core/limits/API changes, no saved S4/native geometry edits, no production switch gate, production/frame/RSS/parallel/variable-font guarantees.

validation.core_standard_matrix: Not repeated: engine/standard harness exact .13 fingerprints; repository CI still required.

adoption: Use both bounded mapping windows and lazy selection index in private development caller output; preserve existing fresh caller interfaces and full source/link geometry contract.
